FN-6DRIZ31-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 111
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Randall Shedd
Commissions
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/04/2025
House Bill 111 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Home Builders Licensure
Board until October 1, 2029 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. The provisions of this bill
will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
